purpose: Require safety guidance whenever a recommended capability can access private data or make external changes.

rules.permission: Read mailbox content; draft or send messages.
rules.what_can_go_wrong: Private content may be exposed or a message may be sent to the wrong recipient.
rules.safe_use: Start read-only, summarize before acting, and ask before sending.

rules.permission: Read, create, modify, or delete calendar events.
rules.what_can_go_wrong: Meetings can be changed, duplicated, or scheduled at the wrong time.
rules.safe_use: Confirm the event details and time zone before any write.

rules.permission: Read, share, organize, modify, or delete private cloud files.
rules.what_can_go_wrong: Sensitive files can be exposed, overwritten, moved, or deleted.
rules.safe_use: Inspect scope first, use copies or dry-runs where possible, and confirm destructive changes.

rules.permission: Read repositories and write branches, commits, pull requests, issues, or workflow changes.
rules.what_can_go_wrong: Code can be changed on the wrong branch, secrets exposed, or production workflows affected.
rules.safe_use: Inspect the repository and diff, use a focused branch, run checks, and confirm before pushing or opening a PR.

rules.permission: Access private systems, data, or custom read and write actions.
rules.what_can_go_wrong: Sensitive data can be queried, changed, or leaked; custom writes can have broad impact.
rules.safe_use: Use least privilege, identify read versus write actions, test safely, and obtain explicit confirmation for writes.

rules.permission: Read, move, rename, modify, export, or delete local files.
rules.what_can_go_wrong: Files can be overwritten, misplaced, or changed in bulk.
rules.safe_use: Confirm paths and targets, test on a sample, and use recoverable or copied outputs where practical.

rules.permission: Create recurring actions, reminders, monitors, or connected writes.
rules.what_can_go_wrong: An incorrect task can repeat, create noise, or repeatedly change external state.
rules.safe_use: Define trigger, scope, stop condition, and notification behavior before enabling it.

rules.permission: Change hosting, configuration, infrastructure, or production services.
rules.what_can_go_wrong: A release can cause downtime, expose configuration, or affect users.
rules.safe_use: Review environment targets, use staging when available, and keep rollback instructions before production deployment.
